purpose: Provider codes of historical states (and a few non-crosswalk entities) -> Wikidata QIDs, so atlas rows and KG statements of the long-run history layer link to KG entities. Provider codes are kept verbatim in the atlas; this file never changes an iso3.
rules: only distinct states/polities are mapped; earlier-border versions of a current country (e.g. GEACRON 'France 1820-1879') are not

each entry was checked against the Wikidata entity (label, description, inception P571, dissolution P576) fetched with wbgetentities through the WDHARVEST locked client; evidence carries the revision id and raw response sha256
valid_from_year/valid_to_year (inclusive) bound period-specific entries (COW state numbers that span several polities); null = the code's whole span
Wikidata is community-edited: QIDs are agent-mapped, pending maintainer review
